title: The Nature of the Church
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: The church is the people of God gathered in Jesus Christ, redeemed by His blood, indwelt by His Spirit, and called to worship, holiness, fellowship, mission, and discipleship. The church is not merely a building, event, organization, or religious service.
summary: The church is the people of God gathered in Jesus Christ, redeemed by His blood, indwelt by His Spirit, and called to worship, holiness, fellowship, mission, and discipleship. The church is not merely a building, event, organization, or religious service.
christFocus: Jesus Christ creates, owns, loves, and builds His church. The church exists because Christ saves sinners, joins them to Himself, gathers them as His people, and sends them into the world as His witnesses.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The church is the redeemed people of God. It is not first a location, program, platform, denomination, or weekly event. The church is made up of those who belong to Christ through faith and are joined together as His people.

Scripture describes the church as a household, a body, a temple, a bride, a flock, and a chosen people. Each picture shows that believers are not meant to live as isolated individuals. They are brought into shared life with God and one another.

The church gathers around the apostles’ teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, prayer, worship, generosity, and mission. Its life is shaped by the Word of God, the Gospel of Christ, the presence of the Spirit, and love among believers.

The church also bears witness to the world. God’s people are called out of darkness into His marvelous light so they may proclaim His excellencies. The church exists for worship, discipleship, holiness, mutual care, and Gospel witness until Christ returns.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people think of church mainly as a building, livestream, religious habit, social club, or painful memory. Others have been wounded by churches and wonder whether the church still matters. Scripture gives a deeper and better vision: the church belongs to Christ, and He has not abandoned His people.

This doctrine helps believers see that church is not an optional accessory to private faith. Christ saves people into a body. Even when local churches are imperfect, the biblical church remains God’s design for worship, growth, care, correction, mission, and belonging.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Do not reduce the church to a place you attend or a service you consume. Seek to live as part of Christ’s people through worship, fellowship, service, prayer, accountability, generosity, and mission. If you have been hurt by people in the church, bring that pain honestly to Christ without giving up on His love for His body.
